title: Skybridge: Progressive Workspace Flowway & Contextual Sidebar Ecosystem
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Current Console navigation mixes global workspace controls, per-workspace routes, and rollouts/cost dashboards into dense affordances. Users (platform engineers & PMs) report confusion when switching context between workloads, unclear where rollout controls live, and difficulty correlating cost spikes to routes or pinned models. Goal: Create a progressive flow (Skybridge) that surfaces the current workspace context, exposes route- and model-level rollouts, and provides a persistent lightweight cost lens without overwhelming primary tasks. This ticket covers design exploration, prototype, and handoff for the contextual sidebar and workspace flow patterns (desktop-first with responsive constraints).
acceptance_criteria: New sidebar prototype shows persistent workspace chip with quick-switcher, a scoped route list, and an expandable cost lens section
Users can start a canary rollout from the route entry (3-click flow) and see immediate preview of rollout metrics in the cost lens
Prototype demonstrates keyboard-first navigation: Cmd/Ctrl+K to open quick-switcher, arrow keys to move between routes, Enter to open route canvas
Design spec includes responsive collapse behavior, ARIA annotations, and token-level cost CTA mappings for PMs and Finance
Handoff includes acceptance QA checklist, front-end component breakdown, and feature flag gating plan for gradual rollout
design_decisions: Adopt a two-column progressive sidebar: primary (workspace & global actions) and secondary contextual column that changes with selected route
Surface cost insights as a collapsible module in the secondary column instead of a modal to reduce context switching
Inline rollout controls are compact (Start Canary / A/B / Rollback) accessible from each route row to meet reliability SLAs
Preserve existing top-level command palette but add 'Jump to workspace route' fuzzy match to bridge discoverability
Expose persistent breadcrumb that encodes model variant, region, and route so engineers can share permalinks
tradeoffs: Adding a second contextual column increases initial visual density — mitigated by collapsed default state and progressive disclosure
Inline rollout controls may tempt less-experienced users to run rollouts; we require confirmation modals and permission gating in the implementation plan
Keeping the cost lens always available improves correlation but could add perceived noise — we will allow teams to pin/unpin the cost module per workspace
implementation_notes: Front-end: New 'contextualColumn' component, aria roles and focus management; deliver with feature flag 'skybridge-context-2026'
Back-end: expose per-route cost summary API endpoint (GET /workspaces/{id}/routes/{route_id}/cost-summary) with 1s P50 SLA
Telemetry: events for 'sidebar.expand', 'route.rollout.start', 'costLens.pin' with route_id, model_variant, and user_tier attributes
Security: rollout actions require 'can_deploy' permission check; coordinate with SSO/SAML team for permission mappings
Rollout: staged release — 10% org opt-in -> 50% workspace pilot -> 100% after 2 week telemetry review
